definitions: An object used to indicate a position, place, or boundary.
A felt-tip pen with a broad tip, used for writing or drawing.
A substance or feature that indicates the presence or existence of something else.
A person who marks something, especially in sports or games.
examples: Place a marker at the spot.
He used a red marker to highlight the text.
This gene is a reliable marker for the disease.
The referee called a foul on the marker.
